messages:
lina: quick heads-up — Prospect Mercurius' search POC is flapping during rerank stage. Posting logs and the two API calls we make.

devon: can you paste the exact client payloads and the route config?

lina: here's the minimal repro from their Node client: 
```
const emb = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-lite-768', input: docs })
}).then(r => r.json())
// emb.data[].embedding -> arrays length 768

await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rerank-default', documents: emb.data.map(d => d.embedding) })
})
```

lina: response is 400 with `embedding_dim_mismatch: expected 1536, got 768`.

maria: that means the rerank route is pinned to a 1536-d model. Which template did the sales team apply?

lina: we used the enterprise-demo template when provisioning the route. I didn't change the model pin.

devon: two paths — make embeddings 1536 by switching encoder model, or re-pin rerank to a 768-compatible variant. For a quick demo, flipping the encoder is lower touch.

lina: merc's CTO is worried about costs — they're on trial credits. Any guidance?

finance: FYI: embed-large-1536 costs ~2.4x embed-lite-768. For a short demo we can issue a $150 credit top-up; need the customer account id.

lina: thanks, i'll DM the acct id.

lina: also saw intermittent 429s when they batch ~200 docs. Logs show `RateLimitError: items_in_batch>max_allowed (max=64)`.

maria: on hosted plans the practical per-request soft limit for large models is 50–64 items. If clients send a huge array you'll hit 429s. Recommend client batching <=32 for consistent latency, or use streaming batching when throughput is high.

devon: we should add resilience guidance: exponential backoff with jitter + idempotency header. Recommended: base 200ms, factor 2, max 6s, full jitter.

lina: implemented that and reduced batch_size to 30 — 429s dropped significantly in their QA run.

lina: small request from Mercurius security: do embeddings get persisted in logs and what's retention? Also can we mask embeddings in transit or at rest?

security-bot: short answer: embeddings are treated as customer data. For hosted trials default log retention is 14 days and embedding vectors are redacted in access logs by default. We can enable additional redaction or shorten retention to 7/3/0 days for the POC if you file a request. For private deployments we support configurable retention and encryption setups.

maria: i'll prepare a one-paragraph blurb for their security questionnaire and attach our SOC2 summary.

devon: a few technical follow-ups from eng: add a preflight validator in the pipeline to assert vector length before calling rerank, and surface a metric for "rerank_dim_mismatch" so we can catch the symptom earlier.

lina: agreed — added this quick JS snippet to the repo: 
```
function assertDim(vec, expected) {
  if (vec.length !== expected) {
    console.error('dim mismatch', vec.length, expected);
    throw new Error('dim_mismatch');
  }
}
```

devon: another ask — Mercurius wanted the platform to auto-project 768->1536 to avoid breaking demos. Is that a thing?

maria: we do not auto-project by default (quality risk). We can offer an opt-in compatibility shim for POCs that applies a small learned linear transform, but it's off by default and requires ops approval. For their short demo we recommend aligning models client-side.

lina: after switching the encoder to `embed-large-1536` and lowering batch_size to 30 the rerank calls succeeded end-to-end in staging. No more dim errors and 429s largely gone.

finance: credit top-up of $150 applied to Mercurius trial account; email confirmation sent.

deploy-bot: Dedicated capacity request submitted for mercurius-poc-dc-88. ETA 75 minutes.

lina: ops asked if we want dedicated capacity for the demo window to stabilize latency — yes please.

devon: couple more pro tips i left in the thread: 1) normalize vectors (L2) if the reranker expects cos-sim, 2) set a client-side metric that counts 429s and dim mismatches and alert if >0.

lina: thanks all — i'm going to close once i get final sign-off from Mercurius. leaving this thread in case anything regresses.
